# input 9 walls / panel seed layout represented explicitly

    src[r][11]=9 if r<=25 else 6
    src[r][20]=9 if r<=25 else 6
# top-left seeds
src[0][0]=1; src[1][1]=8
src[0][12]=3; src[1][13]=2; src[2][14]=7
src[0][21]=8; src[1][22]=6
# middle/right overlay box borders
for c in range(17,24):
    src[7][c]=9; src[14][c]=9
for r in range(7,15):
    src[r][17]=9; src[r][23]=9
for c in range(23,30): src[10][c]=9
src[8][18]=2; src[9][19]=1
# bottom outlined box
for c in range(6,20): src[25][c]=9
for r in range(25,30): src[r][6]=9; src[r][19]=9
src[27][8]=2
# Mark 9-line coordinates to preserve
walls={(r,c) for r in range(N) for c in range(N) if src[r][c]==9}
out=[[6]*N for _ in range(N)]
def paint_rect(r0,r1,c0,c1,seq):
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            d=min(r-r0,r1-r,c-c0,c1-c)
            out[r][c]=seq[d%len(seq)]
paint_rect(0,24,0,10,[1,8])
paint_rect(0,24,12,19,[3,2,7])
paint_rect(0,29,21,29,[8,6])
# Fill inset box interior with rings based on its diagonal code
paint_rect(8,13,18,22,[2,1])
# bottom box interior: a single color code
paint_rect(26,29,7,18,[2])
# Preserve all input walls
for r,c in walls: out[r][c]=9
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
